thread:
marc: weird bug while onboarding with the python sampleapp. batch helper sends 4 inputs, backend returns 4 embeddings but item #3 is 1538 dims, rest 1536. curl + no gzip -> all good.
anya: oof. python sdk version? sampleapp?
marc: py-sdk 1.2.0, sampleapp v0.4.1. repro seems tied to ENABLE_GZIP=true in env. disabling gzip makes the problem disappear.
sam: could compression change byte alignment and screw up our float decode? backend should validate length.
rachel: do you have raw request/response (trimmed)?
marc: request sent by batch helper (pseudo):
```py
client.embeddings.create(model='openembed-1536', input=['x1','x2','x3','x4'], batch_size=4)
# helper concatenates bytes with bytearray.extend then slices offsets
```
response excerpt: 
```
{"data":[{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1538 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]}]}
```
marc: when I repeat with HTTP_PROXY=127.0.0.1:8080 and record traffic I see the client sends a gzipped body, server returns gzipped body. but on a retry path the client transforms the body differently: the gzip wrapper adds a 2-byte header when replaying, which ends up as two extra float bytes after decoding.
anya: so this is retry path + compression interplay. which retry triggered? 429 or 401?
marc: 429 rate-limit on first attempt. sdk retry backoff kicks in and replays the batch. the code that reserializes the batch uses gzip.compress on the already-compressed buffer (double compress) due to a missed flag, causing those extra bytes.
sam: interesting. double-gzip might produce slightly different stream leading to decode padding. backend accepts it and decodes to floats, so vector length becomes wrong. we should fail fast if dimensions mismatch.
rachel: i can repro with a small harness. steps: 1) enable gzip 2) mock 429 on first attempt 3) run batch helper 4) inspect embedding lengths.
anya: good catch. plan: 1) add server-side model-dim validation + reject with 400 when mismatch (quick patch) 2) add a client-side check in py-sdk to assert embedding length equals model.dim before returning and raise if not (safety net) 3) fix retry logic to avoid double-compress and add unit tests for compressed retry path 4) update sampleapp docs and troubleshooting note about toggling ENABLE_GZIP if weird dims observed.
marc: filed INF-2270 for py-sdk double-compress + INF-2271 for server dim check.
ci-bot: created issue INF-2270 and INF-2271, linked to pipelines #842 and #843.
sam: also add note in rerank helper that embeddings must be validated per-item before pairing, otherwise ordering + dim mismatches can silently ruin rerank scores.
rachel: will send a small PR with repro test and fix for py-sdk retry encoder.
anya: i'll do the server dim validation change and add an e2e test.
marc: thanks all. this was a nasty onboarding friction, glad we have a clear fix path. :pray:
